decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that fully captures the necessary refund-policy impact: exactOutputSingle obtains exactly 15 USDC and returns unused value as ETH.
The source changes only the ETH-to-USDC swap path; direct USDC wallet minting remains unchanged.
The Transak fiat-conversion flow is separate from the connected-wallet ETH swap method and remains deferred and unchanged.
Changing the internal ETH swap method does not change which wallet payment methods are disclosed or selectable.
The exactOutputSingle decision does not alter the rule governing when mint-success feedback may be displayed.
Seedless wallet provisioning for fiat buyers is independent of the ETH wallet mint swap implementation.
The 15 USDC swap output target implements the existing mint price but does not change any revenue-allocation amount or recipient.
The source does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are registered and counted.
The ETH swap method and shortfall behavior do not change the optional tipping interface or its configured amounts.
The source is an internal ETH swap implementation decision and does not necessarily require any change to the current product FAQ content.
NFT metadata identity, counters, badges, and ebook references are unaffected by the ETH-to-USDC swap method.
The source does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
